note: Regression for hif-backend#61, which printed a one-bit replication operand without its size. Behavioral rather than plain, and for a measured reason: verilog2hif accepts a concatenation whose operands have indefinite width, so the reparse step passes on exactly the output no simulator will elaborate. Only a pipeline that compiles the regenerated design catches it. The constant replications were checked by hand not to have been folded away - the regenerated file still spells them as nested concatenations of sized literals - and one replication is over a signal, where folding is not available at all and the trace has to carry it.
